decision: Source-grounded plan is suitable for a minimal probe-only driver/adaptation and separate one-attempt authorization. It is not an executable runner or execution authorization.

minimalNextProbeContract.accounting: Retain failures and elapsed/setup/provisioning effort. Cost is unknown/null; no token or network cost inference.
minimalNextProbeContract.authorization: Separate coordinator review/authorization binding exact driver/plan/input/output/scratch identity and one attempt; no authorization is emitted here.
minimalNextProbeContract.deadlineInterpretation: At most60seconds total for the probe stage including both commands/observation, charged to shared900second work budget; cleanup at most60seconds; no retry or resource increase.
minimalNextProbeContract.implementationGate: Adapt the existing reviewed bounded preparation transport for these two commands; bind its exact closure and pass focused fake lifecycle/inspect/deadline/receipt controls before authorization.
minimalNextProbeContract.inputs: Exact immutable b47 image, probe bytes/hash and audited uv/interpreter identity; no repository/lock/dependency/gold/profile/credential provisioning or inherited host environment.
minimalNextProbeContract.isolation: Fresh nonroot1000:1000 readonly-root container, network none from creation, no host mounts/socket, drop ALL capabilities/no-new-privileges/private PID/IPC/cgroup policy, explicit exec workspace/tmpfs and strict actual inspect checks.
minimalNextProbeContract.observations: Retain bounded raw stdout/stderr/exit/error/argv/timing, exact image/tools/probe before-after and actual inspect plus cleanup/absence on every path. Validate actual3.11 patch, platform/ABI, executableSHA, uv0.13.6, isolated1/noSite1, sys.path and absent unexpected Python configuration. Unknown/refused options or missing observations stay failure/incomplete.

remainingQualificationGaps: Probe driver and actual probe are unrun; exact native3.11 patch/uv flags/sys.path/platform still unobserved.
Wheel-only locked installation requires separate authorization after probe disposition; candidate filenames are not complete resolver/ABI evidence.
Any cache links/type/lock/protected-source audit and fresh offline reproduction remain separate; do not silently project or dereference.
Bridge download policy is not an egress firewall, store/archive caps are not cumulative wire-byte measurement, and preparation cost remains null absent measurement.
Native collection and trusted complete phase/source/setup/process/capture joins remain missing;157static source slots are not native IDs or forced native counts.
reviewerContext: Reviewer previously assessed the Python01 source union and oracle preparation; independent code/source review, not a blind consumer trial.
sourceJudgments: CPython3.11 is a defensible first candidate: project and lock permit it, maintainer Dockerfile uses python:3.11, retained grammar and selected wheel filenames do not establish a need for3.12. They do not establish native dependency or import success.

Owned probe is stdlib-only, hashes its actual executable, reports ABI/platform/flags/path/config, and contains no task import, subprocess or package execution. Plan controls parse it without executing it.
Retained image inventory binds regular0755 /usr/bin/python3.11 and /usr/local/bin/uv. Bare uv must resolve through the unchanged audited image PATH, not a host executable.

Later metadata-only locked wheel installation is a distinct unauthorized stage: dev dependency group, no optional dev extra, no project build and no dependency source build. Exact uv option/runtime behavior remains to observe.
Source-root imports, dotenv/config absence, real subprocess/loopback behavior, cache type/content and native IDs/phase joins remain unobserved. No stub or global PYTHONPATH repair is proposed.
